eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Chelan, WA; at 9:12 AM on AUG 23, 2015 Effective until 10:12 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This message is from the Chelan County Sheriff's Office:  First Creek Fire information bulletin.  The fire service will be conducting burnout operations between Morning Sun Drive and Fields Point on the south side of the South Shore road.  The burnout operations are scheduled for some time today (Sunday 8 23).  South Shore road will likely be closed during the burnout operation. If you are within the burnout area we strongly suggest you evacuate.  This concludes this message from the Chelan County Sheriff's Office.
